exceptions.reason: @polyspec/ordered-json is not on the npm registry; the root package.json takes it from the tarball of its GitHub release through overrides, and the package declares the exact version of that release.
exceptions.removalCondition: ordered-json publishes @polyspec/ordered-json to the npm registry, or the pin moves to the tarball of its newer release (checklist rows T43.5-5, T43.6-1, T43.6-3, T43.7-5 and G5.90).

exceptions.reason: typescript 7 is the native compiler and has no JavaScript API, while packages/orm-npm/src/generate/scan.ts reads the syntax tree with the API of the typescript package; typescript 6.0.3 is the latest release with that API.
exceptions.removalCondition: the scanner of packages/orm-npm/src/generate/scan.ts reads the syntax tree through an API that typescript 7 provides.

exceptions.reason: The types of @types/node follow the Node.js major release, and packages/orm-npm declares engines.node >=22.16.0, so the types of the lowest supported major release keep the package from using an API that the minimum Node.js lacks.
exceptions.removalCondition: engines.node of packages/orm-npm/package.json is raised to a release of the major release of the latest @types/node.
